d: Two brothers running a tailoring business secretly engage in illegal activities that exploit their customers' trust. When one family becomes affected by their actions, they decide to fight back. Their determination helps uncover the entire racket.

A Man Falls For A Woman Who Exploits His Affection For Money, Working With An Accomplice To Rob Him. As He Loses His Savings And His Marriage Begins To Collapse, He Must Face The Consequences Of His Choices.

A Widow Is Having An Affair With Her Brother-In-Law. The Mother-In-Law Always Suspects About The Affair. She Tries To Get Her Son Married To Another Woman. This Is When Envy Takes Place And Things Go Berserk.

What appears to be an ordinary household is driven by secrets, resentment, and unspoken desires. As trust breaks down, one decision triggers an irreversible chain of events. The journey concludes with justice prevailing over deception.

A Married Woman Becomes Increasingly Frustrated By The Challenges In Her Marital Relationship. Desperate To Keep A Deeply Personal Family Secret From Becoming Public, She Begins To Manipulate A Loyal Household Employee Into Helping Her. As Pressure, Fear, And Emotional Conflict Intensify, The Lives Of Everyone Involved Are Pushed Toward A Tragic And Unforeseen Turning Point.

A newly married woman becomes involved in a secret relationship that threatens the peace of her household. As hidden truths emerge, a series of tragic events shakes the family. A determined investigation uncovers a web of deception, leading the police to the real culprits.

A Married Man Marries Another Woman Because He Is Unable To Conceive With His First Wife. He, Along With His Mother-In-Law Ill-Treat His First Wife And Keep Her Home As A Maid. The Second Wife Always Suspects Something Fishy In This House And Confronts Her Husband And Mother-In-Law.
